correctness.rationale: The given incidence basis p0,pi,ri has products p_i²=p_i, p0 r_i=r_i=r_i p_i; the twisted Leibniz identities from idempotents, orthogonality and arrows yield unique α_i for moved leaves, β_i,δ_i all leaves. A fixed leaf has δ_i=0, β_i free, rank 0 or 1. For swapped pair (i,j), D²=0 equations force either u=0 (then v=di=dj=0, bi,bj unrestricted), or u≠0 and v=-u, dj=-di, di²=u², with q²-1 odd-char or q(q-1) char2 rank-two choices. Distinct leaf orbits have disjoint image support, and D(p0) is dependent, so local ranks add. Independent complete parameter-to-matrix squaring for one swapped pair yielded q2 1+2T+3T², q3 1+4T+12T², q5 1+8T+40T². Arbitrary s,f follows algebraic orbit independence, not tests.
